verdict.rationale: Appwrite documents its own exit path: one-click migrations between Appwrite Cloud and self-hosted (appwrite-docs-43), backed by Docker-based self-hosting with full control over data location (appwrite-docs-14, appwrite-docs-24). Its dedicated native PostgreSQL option can be reached directly with psql and comes with backups (appwrite-docs-8, appwrite-docs-46), and storage offers file download APIs (appwrite-docs-10). However, nothing documents a single export of all project data (users, rows, files) in open, portable formats for leaving the platform entirely. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export feature, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON/SQL dumps) across all services, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
